title: Green Light District
summary: Smart traffic lights that pace cyclists to a green.
description:
A physical model junction built with 3D-printed parts: speed sensors detect approaching vehicles and cyclists, and the lights turn green at the right moment while meeting safety minimums.

LEDs along the bike path light up at the speed a cyclist needs to keep to reach the next light on green.

image.alt: Model road with two wooden traffic lights and a painted bike lane
